cleanup.postgres: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE datname='zitadel' AND pid<>pg_backend_pid(); DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS zitadel; DROP ROLE IF EXISTS zitadel;

description: addon-ssl + addon-mtls, pure cert auth (no password) — Zitadel presents its addon-mtls client certs to postgres/mtls-zitadel, which enforces 'hostssl ... cert' in pg_hba.conf. mtls_cns=zitadel\npostgres issues two client certs (CN=zitadel for the login role, CN=postgres for the bootstrap superuser). conf-enable-mtls-app.sh splits zitadel.yaml Database User.SSL -> /certs/mtls/zitadel/ and Admin.SSL -> /certs/mtls/postgres/. Distinct from zitadel/mtls-certonly: this variant has its OWN postgres/mtls-zitadel backing (stack_name='mtls-zitadel'), so its persistent volumes (zitadel.yaml, masterkey) never share storage with another zitadel variant. The previous shared-stack-name='ssl' design caused volume-suffix collisions: zfs-cloned a partially-mutated yaml from zitadel/ssl's slot and 155-conf-write-zitadel-yaml's 'skip if exists' kept the stale mtls config.
